identity.mission: Create a 'Barista Luxury' mobile web experience that feels like a boutique coffee shop in your pocket.
core_principles: Fusion: Digital Convenience x Old World Cafe Aesthetics
Content: Coffee is the hero. Use close-ups and rich textures.
Negative Space: Generous cream-colored breathing room.

usage.secondary_cta: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#8B6914] text-[#8B6914] hover:bg-[#8B6914] hover:text-white

colors.dark_mode_strategy: The 'Night Roast' Mode. Background becomes Deep Espresso (#1A120B), Text becomes Cream (#F5F0E1), Accents remain Gold.

headings.usage: Use for Page Titles, Product Names, and 'Espresso Beso' branding. Tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use for all UI elements, menus, descriptions, and buttons. Excellent legibility.

spacing.mobile_optimized: Ensure touch targets are min 44px. Use pb-24 for pages with bottom nav.

textures.grain: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay on the Cream background to simulate high-quality paper.

mobile_first.navigation: Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar (Home, Menu, Order, Profile).
mobile_first.header: Minimal sticky header with Logo (Left) and Cart (Right).
mobile_first.cards: Full width on mobile with p-4 internal padding.

bento_grid.rules: Mix tall product shots with square category tiles.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-lg

cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group relative
cards.zone_selector: bg-white/50 border border-[#8B6914]/20 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3 active:bg-[#8B6914]/10 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border-none shadow-inner rounded-lg p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B6914]

map.style: Custom marker icons (Coffee Cup). Map tiles should be 'Alidade Smooth' or similar muted style to match the cream theme.

implementation_steps: 1. Setup Tailwind Theme: Extend colors with 'cream', 'gold', 'burgundy'. Add fonts.
2. Install Dependencies: npm install leaflet react-leaflet @types/leaflet
3. Create Layout Wrapper: Implement the 'App Shell' with bottom navigation for mobile.
4. Build Components: Button, ZoneCard, ProductCard (with customization modal), CartDrawer.
5. Map Integration: Build the 'LiveLocationMap' component using Leaflet.
6. Pages: Home (Landing + Zone), Menu (Product List), Cart, Admin Dashboard.
universal_guidelines: NEVER use default blue links. All interactive elements must be Gold or Burgundy.
Use 'Sonner' for toasts (Order added, Payment success).
Ensure the 'Zone Selector' is the first thing users see on mobile (besides the hero).
All prices should be formatted as $X.XX
Admin Dashboard should use the 'High Density' Grid layout but keep the warm theme.
IMPORTANT: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
